name: game-start
description: Invoke when the user wants to start a new game project, set up project scaffolding, onboard into an existing codebase, or initialize GameForge session state. Triggers on: "start a game", "new game project", "set up project", "project onboarding", "initialize project". Do NOT invoke for brainstorming ideas (use game-brainstorm) or prototyping mechanics (use game-prototype). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
